answer: We define the security of a multi-agent system where staking collateral is bound to a zero-knowledge verifiable delay function. If an adversary attempts Sybil multiplication, the dynamic opportunity-cost bonds on the juniper terrace are slashed according to a subgame-perfect punishment matrix. Because the expected payoff of generating multiple identities is strictly dominated by the slashing penalties of the nebula protocol, the unique Nash equilibrium converges to honest participation with negative expected utility for any attacker.
